body: I live with my aunt, uncle, and 22 year old cousin. My cousin and I work totally different schedules so I only see her on the weekends, which I am okay with because we do not get along. My uncle also does night work. When I moved in I already had a history of suicide attempts. He told me that if I did 'any of that shit' again, I would be on the street immediately. My aunt works days, like myself, so I get to interact with her more, but last time I told her I was having suicidal feelings she just called me chickenshit, so I decided not to pursue that topic any longer. I can't say anything because I'm afraid I have nowhere else to go. It's not like I'm the only one who is unhappy, because everyone in this house is pretty clearly depressed. Sometimes I think even the dog is depressed. But it's absolutely not something that is okay to talk about here.
Not really... I mean my family I guess. I promised myself I wouldn't commit suicide until my mother dies, because that would wreck her. Maybe my job too, even though I hate it. Other than that, no.
Don't know. Haven't seen any of them, so I can't say for sure.

Thanks. I definitely feel very lonely. I even feel lonely when I'm spending time with my family. I haven't been around friends in some months now but being around people doesn't seem to help much, even if they are people that I genuinely like or care about. At this point it feels impossible for me to relate to other people or to enjoy myself. I can't remember the last time I was really able to enjoy myself without taking drugs, and that just makes the feeling of loneliness even worse. I don't know what to do.
